Data is the simplest type of datasource in the CMS.
It lets you enter your own custom data directly, without connecting to any external systems or APIs.

You can think of it as a small, built‑in data editor.
You type in the information you want, and the CMS makes it available to widgets, lists, components, or other areas that support datasources.

Use it whenever you want:

    A quick way to supply test data
    A small list of items (categories, tags, statuses, etc.)
    A fixed dataset that doesn’t need to come from a server
    A way to prototype how a component behaves with real‑looking data

## When should I use a Data datasource?

Choose “Data” when you want something quick, local, and easy.

It is perfect for:

* Dropdown options (categories, statuses, types)
* Sample data for designing or configuring components
* Quick prototypes before connecting a real backend
* Simple informational blocks or lists

You should use another type of datasource if:

* You need live data from an API
* The information changes over time
* You want to combine multiple datasources
* You need to run queries or filters

If you just need a list, or a few rows of data, or some mock content, Data is ideal.

## Why is this useful?

The Data datasource helps you design and configure the CMS without waiting on developers or backend systems.

It lets you:

* Try out layouts using sample content
* Build components before real data exists
* Control exactly what data is shown
* Refine the look and behavior of widgets without external dependencies

It is one of the easiest ways to get started using datasources.
